# Propagator

Source: [`Kernel/Propagator.wl`](../../Kernel/Propagator.wl) · Design notes: [MODULES.md](../MODULES.md#propagator-kernelpropagatorwl--buildpropagator)

BuildPropagator: G = (Gamma2 + R)^-1 in abstract entry atoms, its common denominator Delta(w) Delta(-w), the coefficients of Delta and the conditions for its roots to lie in the upper half plane. Objective, assumptions and checks: docs/MODULES.md section "Propagator".

## Symbols

### `BuildPropagator`

`BuildPropagator[vertices, regulator]` inverts Gamma2 + R in abstract entry atoms and returns the "Propagator" stage.

### `GammaAtom`

`GammaAtom[a, b, m][s]` is the coefficient of (I w)^m in (Gamma2 + R)\_ab(w) at q^2 = s, for a before b in field order (the (b, a) entry is the same polynomial at -w). Kept abstract until the end (primer rule 1).

### `Δ`

`Δ[w, s]` = det of the (phi, phibar) block of Gamma2 + R at frequency w, q^2 = s: Delta(w) = c0 + c1 (I w) + c2 (I w)^2 with c\_m = `DeltaCoefficient[m][s]`. Its roots are the poles of the retarded propagator.

### `DeltaCoefficient`

`DeltaCoefficient[m][s]` is the coefficient c\_m of (I w)^m in Delta(w) at q^2 = s (abstract).

### `PropagatorMatrix`

`PropagatorMatrix[prop, w, s]` is G(w) at q^2 = s in field order, in GammaAtom atoms and `Δ[+-w, s]`.

### `FullMatrix`

`FullMatrix[prop, w, s]` is (Gamma2 + R)(w) at q^2 = s in GammaAtom atoms.

### `AtomRules`

`AtomRules[prop]` are the rules `GammaAtom[a, b, m]` -> `Function[s, explicit value]` (couplings, shapes `r[s/k^2]`).

### `DeltaRules`

`DeltaRules[prop]` are the rules expressing Δ and DeltaCoefficient in GammaAtom atoms.

### `ValidityConditions`

`ValidityConditions[prop]` are the inequalities (in DeltaCoefficient atoms) for all roots of Delta(w) to lie in the upper half plane.

### `ShowPropagator`

`ShowPropagator[prop, {a, b}]` prints G\_ab(w, q) in atoms; `ShowPropagator[prop]` prints the atoms, Delta and the validity conditions.
